== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Sola Kalter]], known as the Fallen Sword, is an independent agent recognized for her long-standing crusade against the [[Iron Legion]]. She is a formidable combatant characterized by an extraordinary ability to utilize [[Aethertech]] weaponry, a skill that has allowed her to sustain her solo campaign. Her appearance is defined by masterwork gray power armor that resembles an advanced version of standard [[Galactic Union]] combat gear, featuring a reflective green visor. In battle, she utilizes various high-level weapons, including a specialized gun called [[Worldslayer]]—described as a collection of crimson razors—and a [[force-blade]]. Her combat prowess is significant enough to crumble the massive shields of a [[Grand Hive]] with a single shot from her [[Aethertech]] equipment. While she remains somewhat of an enigma to others, her dedication to her mission is well-documented.}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The Fallen Sword is a famous individual and an independent agent who conducts a personal crusade against the [[Iron Legion]]. Known by this title or codename, Sola Kalter{{!}}Sola is often addressed by civilians using the name. Appearing as a tall figure clad in gray powered armor with a reflective green visor, she is equipped with an [[Aethertech weapon]]. During her operations, she has been observed raiding an [[Iron Legion Hive]].}}
